question: A 39-year-old pregnant woman at 16 weeks gestation recently underwent a quad-screen which revealed elevated beta-hCG, elevated inhibin A, decreased alpha-fetoprotein, and decreased estradiol. An ultrasound was performed which found increased nuchal translucency. Which of the following is recommended for diagnosis?

options.opa: Fetus is normal, continue with pregnancy as expected
options.opb: Confirmatory amniocentesis and chromosomal analysis of the fetal cells
options.opc: Biopsy and pathologic examination of fetus

analysis: Given the findings of the quad-screen and ultrasound, there is a high suspicion of a chromosomal abnormality in the fetus. Confirmatory testing through amniocentesis and chromosomal analysis of the fetal cells is recommended to provide a definitive diagnosis.
